prompt:
[TASK]
Create a dedicated coherent minimized-state chrome donor for the exact Japanese 所持アイテム inventory window. Recompose this specific 280 by 137 window into a compact 180 by 18 title bar at the top-left. It must be a newly resolved endpoint for Inventory, never a crop and never a reused window bar.

[REFERENCE ROLE]
Reference image 1 is the authoritative 所持アイテム window and fixes its exact pale-blue chrome, pixel density, stepped corner language, title-bar lighting, and one-pixel border weights.

[PRESERVATION INVARIANTS]
- Keep the Inventory source palette, hard aliased edges, one-pixel border rhythm, and six-pixel stepped corner character.
- The compact bar has complete left, top, newly resolved right, and bottom chrome.
- Remove every item cell, category tab, scrollbar, title glyph, icon, and button; those remain independent editable elements.
- Do not copy the Basic Info or Status compact asset. Derive only from the supplied Inventory reference.

[CANVAS AND LAYOUT]
- Return a 1120 by 548 output canvas, four times the 280 by 137 reference.
- Place one four-times compact 180 by 18 title surface at x=0 y=0 and fill all remaining canvas pixels with neutral white review field.
- Resolve the compact right endcap at source x=179.

[REGION EDITS]
- REGION: Inventory minimized chrome
  CHANGE: Remove the complete body and regenerate only an empty compact 180 by 18 Inventory title surface with continuous source-matched chrome and a complete right endcap.
  PRESERVE: Inventory title palette; hard pixel-scale border; stepped source corners

[STYLE SYSTEM]
- authentic late-1990s Japanese desktop RPG raster UI
- crisp low-resolution pale-blue Inventory chrome

[ASSET RULES]
- Exactly one empty compact title surface at top-left.
- No glyphs, pseudo-text, icon, button, inventory cell, tab, scrollbar, or second window.

[NEGATIVE CONSTRAINTS]
- No crop, squeezed window, Basic Info bar, Status bar, modern rounded card, soft shadow, glass, gibberish, or magenta background.

[QUALITY GATE]
- All four compact edges are complete.
- No inventory body content survives.
- The endpoint differs from every other window and reads as newly generated Inventory chrome.
